connections.title: Email
connections.description: Sends registration, activation and account mails to organisations and their users.

adapter.simulatedMessage: The null transport is selected, so no mail leaves stackiq. Pick a real transport in the Email configuration section.

connections.unconfiguredMessage: Not checked yet. Save the Email configuration section, and stackiq checks the settings.

connections.title: Catalog federation
connections.description: Announces this catalog to directory.opencatalogi.nl and pulls published entries from peer catalogs, through OpenCatalogi.
connections.disabledMessage: Federation is switched off. Set the federation_enabled app setting to true with occ to switch it on.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: Not checked yet. Choose Pull now in the Catalog federation section to check the peers.

connections.title: End-of-life feed
connections.description: Reads product cycles from endoflife.date through integriq, and stamps end-of-support dates on module versions.
connections.disabledMessage: End-of-life sync is switched off. Switch it on in the End-of-life feed sync section.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: Not checked yet. Choose Sync now in the End-of-life feed sync section.

connections.title: Service desk
connections.description: Keeps applications, connections, licences and contracts in step with TOPdesk or ServiceNow, through integriq flows. The service desk owns its fields, stackiq owns its own.
connections.disabledMessage: The service desk exchange is not set up. Set it up in the Service desk exchange section.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: Not checked yet. The first import run reports here.
